headline: On last trading day, Sensex slipped into red while Nifty gained 75 points amidst six-week falling streak.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Volatile global oil prices influenced overall trader sentiment.
Concerns surrounding US Fed interest rate stance weighed on the market.
Key developments around Tata Sons acted as crucial triggers.
Sustained pressure led SENSEX and NIFTY50 to fall for a 6th straight week.
whatHappening: Sensex slipped into the red after CAS while Nifty managed a 75-point gain in the last session.
Both Sensex and Nifty wrapped up their 6th consecutive week of losses.
Paytm attracted market focus amidst volatility and opening updates.
Maruti Suzuki unveiled its S-CNG range aiming for 1 million green vehicle sales by FY27.

summary:
The Indian share market is closed today, Saturday, 19 September 2026, due to the weekend.
In the last trading session, Sensex slipped into the red while Nifty gained 75 points, marking a 6th straight week of market falls.
Trading activity on the NSE and BSE will resume on Monday, 21 September.
